Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 36 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 22 July 2025(Tuesday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Bataan and Cavite(Bacoor, Imus, Kawit, Cavite City, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza, General Trias).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Rizal, Zambales, Pampanga, Bulacan, Laguna, Batangas and Cavite(Alfonso, Amadeo, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Indang, Magallanes, Maragondon, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Ternate, Trece Martires, Carmona, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Naic).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Quezon and Nueva Ecija.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

WEATHER UPDATE: PAGASA reports that as of 2:00 AM, 22 July 2025, a Red Warning Level has been raised over Metro Manila, Bataan, and Cavite (Bacoor, Imus, Kawit, Cavite City, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza, General Trias) due to the Southwest Monsoon (Habagat). Serious flooding is expected in low-lying and flood-prone areas.

An Orange Warning Level is in effect for Rizal, Zambales, Pampanga, Bulacan, Laguna, Batangas, and other areas of Cavite, signaling that flooding remains threatening.

A Yellow Warning Level has been issued for Tarlac, Quezon, and Nueva Ecija, with flooding still possible.

Stay safe, KaTribu!
